final: WITH counts AS (SELECT tr.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink COLLATE BINARY = tr.transreg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS n FROM counts), shares AS (SELECT c.order_type_mix, c.record_count, 1.0 * c.record_count / t.n AS share FROM counts AS c JOIN total AS t ON t.n IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.order_type_mix, s.record_count, s.share, s.share - m.value FROM shares AS s JOIN mean_share AS m ON m.value IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > m.value
